prompt:
Implement provider-reported charge reconciliation in the selected usage-footer subsystem. This is a new feature, not a claim of an existing production defect. SessionLedger currently estimates every attributable request using PricingResolver. Preserve that fallback and its canonical/tier pricing behavior, but allow durable provider charge observations to replace estimates per request.

Add exported REPORTED_COST_ENTRY = "usage-footer-reported-cost" in session-ledger.ts and a ReportedCostRecord interface in domain.ts with targetEntryId, accountKey, providerId, amount, currency, source, recordedAt. The first three and source are nonempty strings; amount is a finite nonnegative number; currency must be exactly "USD"; recordedAt is a finite nonnegative number. Accept only custom entries with this customType and a valid non-array object data payload. Ignore malformed records without throwing. Records may occur before their targets. For each target, consider only records matching the selected accountKey AND the request's providerId; greatest recordedAt wins, with later array position breaking ties. A newer invalid or foreign-account record must not hide an older applicable record.

Keep the existing attribution rules for assistant, compaction and branch_summary usage, legacy resolution, tool exclusion and attributed/excluded counters. Charges cannot attribute otherwise excluded entries, and orphan charges contribute nothing. Provider identity must also equal the selected account.providerId before a charge can apply. For an eligible request, a valid charge replaces the entire estimate, even for a zero-dollar charge or a model with no registry price. Sum charges into reported; never infer reported charges from Usage.cost (those are locally calculated). Only requests without a valid charge contribute to estimated, hasEstimatedUsage, hasUnpricedUsage and pricingSources. Do not mutate entries or pricing metadata. Do not persist pricing rates or fetch external data.

The workspace is a selected real subsystem from mical-pi. Follow its TypeScript style and node:test conventions. Add tests as needed; existing tests must continue to pass.
notes: Run commands from the baseline workspace root. Copy hidden/ there only after completion. Overlay reference/ only for trusted author validation. Offline; tsx is supplied by the parent dependency mount.
